title: Refresh homepage brand, navigation, hero, and footer
context: Update the homepage shell to the latest desktop and mobile Figma frames. The work introduces the supplied inline-ready wordmark, consolidates contact CTA styling, replaces the hero artwork and typography while retaining responsive height behavior, and simplifies the footer with legal placeholder routes. Figma sources: desktop node 228:52 and mobile node 371:112 in file 0J2JF0nYrI8EJrttdHNes4.

tasks.title: Extract the unified gradient button primitive
acceptance_criteria: A unified Button primitive renders an accessible link when passed href and a native button otherwise, sharing the gradient background, animated hover sweep, visible white focus outline, active scale, typography, and reduced-motion behavior
The Button primitive accepts default and small sizes, with default selected when size is omitted
The small size uses a 16px font with 8px vertical and 24px horizontal padding
The homepage contact control uses the native Button while retaining its mobile full-width and desktop minimum-width layout
Browser coverage verifies semantic button/link rendering and the shared hover, focus, and active states across Button variants
npm run verify passes

tasks.title: Update the navigation brand and scroll behavior
acceptance_criteria: The home link renders the supplied wordmark as inline SVG with its original 163 by 28 viewBox geometry and currentColor paths
The brand link retains the accessible name Brent Walbolt while the SVG is hidden from assistive technology
The navigation bar is exactly 56px tall without duplicated breakpoint height declarations
Desktop navigation remains visible at 48rem and above while the hamburger remains below 48rem
The overlay header is transparent at the top and changes to black after scrolling more than 8px at mobile and desktop widths
The navigation CTA uses the shared small Button variant
npm run verify passes

tasks.title: Implement the redesigned responsive hero
acceptance_criteria: The hero uses bg-home-hero-mobile.svg below 48rem and bg-home-hero.svg at 48rem and above
The hero has no clip-path, raster hero background, or redundant black overlay gradient
The hero remains 400px tall below 48rem and 95vh at 48rem and above
The non-highlight headline copy uses Source Serif 4 ExtraBold Italic while gradient phrases use Switzer ExtraBold
The headline remains centered, the desktop scroll indicator retains its proportional position, and the page has no horizontal overflow
DESIGN.md documents the new hero artwork, typography, square edge, and all-width navigation scroll surface
npm run verify passes

tasks.title: Rebuild the footer and add legal placeholders
acceptance_criteria: The footer contains no brand logo or primary navigation links at any viewport size
Desktop shows the existing tagline and 2026 copyright on the left and legal links on the right with 40px vertical padding
Mobile shows legal links before the copyright with 24px padding and 32px vertical separation
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use link to static branded placeholder pages at /privacy-policy and /terms-of-use
The footer is keyboard accessible and meets the contact section without a visual gap
npm run verify passes
